title: Analysis of Breast Cancer Cell Invasion Using an Organotypic Culture System
author: Romana E. Ranftl
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bn6jmhcn

steps.title: Keep gel components on ice
steps.instruction: Place all gel‑mix components on ice; the protocol uses 1 mL gel mix (with or without fibroblasts) per well of a 24‑well plate and the volume should be scaled up proportionally, preparing excess to compensate for the viscous nature of the components.

steps.title: Combine gel liquids
steps.instruction: Mix 100 µL fetal bovine serum (FBS), 80 µL 5× DMEM, and 120 µL fibroblast culture medium (or other components described in Section 3.1) on ice.

steps.title: Prepare fibroblast suspension
steps.instruction: Trypsinize the fibroblasts (normal fibroblasts or CAFs) from a monolayer, obtain a single‑cell suspension, count the cells, centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, and resuspend the pellet at 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL in fibroblast culture medium.

steps.title: Add fibroblasts to gel mix
steps.instruction: Avoiding bubble formation, add 100 µL of the fibroblast suspension to the gel mix; if a fibroblast‑free gel is required, add 100 µL fibroblast culture medium instead.

steps.title: Dispense gel into wells
steps.instruction: Add the remaining 900 µL of the mixture to each well of a 24‑well plate (total 1 mL per well).

steps.title: Polymerize gel
steps.instruction: Place the plate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 1 hour (01:00:00) to allow the gel to set.

steps.title: Overlay gel with medium
steps.instruction: When the gel is set, add 1 mL of the appropriate culture medium on top and incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Aspirate overlay medium
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate the medium from the 24‑well plate containing the solidified gels.

steps.title: Seed cancer cells
steps.instruction: Apply 100 µL of cancer‑cell suspension onto the top of each gel.

steps.title: Allow cancer cell adhesion
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 6–8 hours (06:00:00 – 08:00:00) to let the cells adhere to the matrix.

steps.title: Prepare coated nylon filters
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 mL cell‑free gel (without fibroblasts) as described in Section 3.1, keep on ice, and coat nylon filters with this gel (1 mL per filter). Separate the coated filters in a culture dish and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour (01:00:00).

steps.title: Fix coated filters
steps.instruction: Fix the coated nylon filters using filter‑fixing solution for at least 2 hours at room temperature or overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Assemble metal bridges and add medium
steps.instruction: Place sterile metal grid bridges in a 6‑well plate with sterile forceps, add cancer‑cell culture medium to the filters and incubate 30 min at 37 °C, then add medium under each bridge until it contacts the nylon filter, avoiding air bubbles.

steps.title: Transfer gels onto filters
steps.instruction: Using a sterile spatula, lift each gel from the 24‑well plate and place it on a coated nylon filter that sits on a metal bridge; the cancer‑cell layer must face upward.

steps.title: Overlay gels with cell‑free gel
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of cell‑free gel mixture on top of each lifted gel and spread evenly over the surface.

steps.title: Culture organotypic system
steps.instruction: Incubate the assembled cultures for 5 days at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, changing the medium daily.

steps.title: Post‑culture fixation
steps.instruction: After 5 days, remove the medium, wash with PBS (or transfer to a new 6‑well plate), turn the gel upside‑down (cancer‑cell layer on the bottom), and fix in 2 mL gel‑fixing solution at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Wash fixed gels
steps.instruction: The next day, wash the gels with 2 mL PBS for 10 minutes (00:10:00) and repeat this wash three times.

steps.title: Process gels for histology
steps.instruction: Using forceps and a scalpel, cut each gel in half; store one half in 70 % ethanol at 4 °C and embed the other half in paraffin blocks for standard H&E staining.

steps.title: Image and quantify invasion
steps.instruction: Take 5–7 bright‑field images per gel at 10× or 20× magnification, measure the non‑invasive and total cancer‑cell areas with ImageJ (or similar), and calculate the Invasion Index as (total area − non‑invasive area) ÷ total area.

steps.title: Optional “killing” assay – remodel gel
steps.instruction: Seed fibroblasts as described earlier, allow them to remodel the gel for 5 days (incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, change medium daily).

steps.title: Fibroblast removal with selection
steps.instruction: Remove the medium and add 1 mL fibroblast culture medium containing the appropriate selection compound (e.g., 10 µg/mL puromycin). Incubate for 48 hours (48:00:00) at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Wash after selection
steps.instruction: Wash the gels three times in fibroblast culture medium, each wash lasting 1 hour (01:00:00).

steps.title: Prepare cancer‑cell suspension
steps.instruction: Trypsinize a monolayer of breast carcinoma cells (4T1, 410.4 or MDA‑MB‑231), count them, and resuspend at 5 × 10⁶ cells/mL in cancer‑cell culture medium.

steps.title: Prepare nylon filters for killing assay
steps.instruction: Prepare one sterile nylon filter per organotypic condition, place filters on top of each other in a culture dish with sterile forceps, and wash the gel‑coated filters with sterile PBS for 10 minutes (×3) to remove fixing solution.

steps.title: Repeat gel preparation (steps 2‑9)
steps.instruction: Follow Section 3.1 “Gel Preparation” steps 2‑9, then after the gel sets add 1 mL fibroblast culture medium on top and return to step 2 of this protocol.

steps.title: Pre‑chill gel components
steps.instruction: Keep all components for gel preparation on ice before use.

steps.title: Additional washes for filters and gels
steps.instruction: Wash gel‑coated nylon filters with sterile PBS for 10 minutes (1/3, 2/3, 3/3) and wash gels with 2 mL PBS for 10 minutes (1/3, 2/3, 3/3) as required.

steps.title: Remove selection compound
steps.instruction: Incubate gels overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ in fibroblast culture medium to eliminate residual selection compound.

steps.title: Final fibroblast‑medium washes
steps.instruction: Wash the gels three times in fibroblast culture medium, each wash lasting 1 hour (01:00:00).
